title: Engram: Multi-Stage Memory for Agentic Tuning of Heterogeneous Models
title_zh: Engram：面向异构模型智能体调优的多阶段记忆
abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can now tune neural networks, yet without cross-session memory they spend costly trials rediscovering known lessons. Reuse is difficult because production models differ in architecture, training setup and inference budget. We present Engram, a memory system that links past trial outcomes with the hypotheses and rationale behind them and assesses whether this evidence applies to the current model. An online agent curates evidence at the decision points where it is needed: Initial Guidance supplies validated lessons at the start, Session Retrieval supplies related past sessions before each batch of hypotheses is generated, and Trial Candidate Review checks each trial candidate against matching past trials. Between sessions, an offline agent distills validated lessons, making the memory self-improving. On two ads models, Engram reaches the 32-trial result of a no-memory control with 47% fewer trials and also ends with a better model on average.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体已能调优神经网络，但缺乏跨会话记忆时，常要耗费昂贵的试验来重新发现已有经验。生产模型在架构、训练设置和推理预算上各不相同，进一步增加了经验复用的难度。Engram 将历史试验结果与背后的假设和依据关联起来，并评估这些证据是否适用于当前模型。在线智能体在三个决策节点筛选证据：Initial Guidance 在会话开始时提供经验证的经验；Session Retrieval 在生成每批假设前检索相关历史会话；Trial Candidate Review 将每项候选试验与匹配的历史试验进行比对。离线智能体则在会话之间提炼经验证的经验，持续改进记忆库。在两个广告模型上，Engram 达到无记忆对照组完成 32 次试验时的效果所需的试验次数少 47%，且最终得到的模型平均表现更好。
key_points_zh: Engram 不只保存试验结果，还记录背后的假设与依据，并判断历史证据能否迁移到架构、训练设置或推理预算不同的模型。
在线记忆覆盖三个决策节点：Initial Guidance 提供启动经验，Session Retrieval 为每批新假设检索相关会话，Trial Candidate Review 逐项比对候选试验与历史记录。
离线智能体在会话之间提炼经验证的经验，供后续调优复用。
在两个广告模型上，Engram 用少 47% 的试验达到无记忆对照组做完 32 次试验时的效果，且最终模型平均表现更好。
